contentEn.title: Luxurious Two Bedroom Apartment in Mar Azul, Estepona
contentEn.summary: free wifi Wonderful and spacious two-bedroom apartment with great views of the sea and the tropical pools of the urbanization. This apartment is part of the Mar Azul urbanization, a project designed by the Mervin Villaroel architecture stud
contentEn.description:
free wifi

 

 Wonderful and spacious two-bedroom apartment with great views of the sea and the tropical pools of the urbanization. This apartment is part of the Mar Azul urbanization, a project designed by the Mervin Villaroel architecture studio, the same one that has designed other unique complexes such as Puente Romano or the Kempinsky hotel, and built with top quality materials.

 This 165 square meter apartment new and decorated in 2015, comprising of: 40 m2 terraces with two different environments, a sofa area and a dining table, a large 45 m2 dining room equipped with a 40 “Sony Smart TV. Two large bedrooms with sea views and a safe. Two marble bathrooms with an area Separate toilets, bathtub, with hydromassage bathtub in one of them and separate shower. Kitchen with Siemens appliances including dishwasher, hob, oven, microwave, refrigerator, washing machine, dryer, Nexpresso coffee machine and all the necessary kitchen utensils.

 Other information of interest:

 – Installation with music in all rooms, bathrooms and terraces

 – Netflix, Amazon and Movistar TV.

 – Air conditioning with heat pump and underfloor heating.

 -Private parking space and outdoor parking included in the rental price.

 – Free Wi-Fi.

 – Marble floors

 – Reception open 24h and security all day

 – Indoor indoor pool, gym, Finnish sauna and steam sauna.

 -Outdoor pool.

 Optional weekly cleaning that can be extended to the desired days for € 12 per hour.

 A 10-minute walk is Laguna Village, a small leisure center with restaurants and small shops. A little further, about 35 mn away, you can walk to the center of Estepona.

 Feel free to contact us if you have any questions, we will be happy to assist you.

 Come and enjoy your holidays with Marbella Skol, the leading holiday rentals agency.
